corrections.reason: The canonical Ge'ez verb in 1 Peter 4:7 is ወጽሕዉ ('be sober unto prayer'), glossed in line 5 as ንቁሀን ፡ ሁኑ and supported by the citation ወጽሕወ ፡ ኖኅ in lines 5-6; Stage 1 misread ጽሕ as ጸል due to ink wear.
The printed glyph at the end of ኃጣውእ is እ (matching line 16 ኃጣውእ), which was misread as ን due to a faded right loop.
The printed character in ለይትለአክ is 1st-order አ (matching line 12 ለይትለአክ), not 4th-order ዓ.
In 1 Peter 4:14 the Ge'ez conditional particle is ወእመሰ ('And if...'); a slight gap and ink speck above ሰ caused Stage 1 to misread it as ቦ.
